risks.risk: Printer may not be functional or may have low ink levels or clogged nozzles.
risks.proof: Video or photo of the printer powering on, printing a test page, and showing ink levels on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in the photo, such as internal mechanical issues or worn rollers.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the paper path, rollers, and internal components, or a video of the printer in operation.

risks.risk: Printer may be missing accessories (e.g., power cord, USB cable, original ink cartridges).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the printer.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo showing all included accessories (power cord, USB cable, etc.).
Close-up of the ink levels on the screen or a photo of the ink cartridges.
response.reason: The model and brand are confirmed, but the 'like new' condition and functionality cannot be verified from the current photo. Hidden risks such as internal damage, ink status, and missing accessories affect pricing and must be proven before a price can be assigned.
